t: What is a Posh Show?
3 Myths About Poshmark Live Shows That You Believe | List Perfectly
s: April 15, 2024 - There are a lot of reasons to attend Posh Shows, and they are not all low prices. Usually, sellers try to use low prices as a gimmick. If you have high-quality, in-demand items, don’t sell them for less than they’re worth. Maybe your buyer just wants to see a curated collection of boho clothing or plus-size professional clothing. Maybe they are not exactly fashion aficionados and they want to know how to style a top or ask you live about the fit.
